svg.title: Multi-region external phone provider architecture with Azure Front Door
svg.desc: Microsoft Entra ID calls one Front Door endpoint. Front Door preserves caller authorization and selects an eligible regional origin. Each regional Function uses the same Easy Auth policy and encryption certificate, with its own Key Vault, OAuth identity, storage, and monitoring. Both origins call the same phone provider. Each surviving region must handle the complete peak workload.
svg.metadata: Microsoft Azure and Entra architecture icons used for documentation under their permitted-use terms: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ and https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/architecture-icons . Product artwork is embedded unchanged.
svg.text: One public URL. Matching caller trust and encryption keys. Independent regional resources.
Region-local host and package storage / independent telemetry
Region-local host and package storage / independent telemetry

text.tspan: Use matching RSA key material in both vaults.
Allow the Front Door service tag and profile ID.
Keep Easy Auth on SendOtp; exempt only
Each region handles the full peak workload.
Test recovery in both directions and record
Use local vault, storage, identities, and telemetry.
